title: Two Seconds at the Office Door
chain: Maya holds the office door for a stranger
the stranger walks in and takes a laptop
the door camera shows Maya letting him in

beats.voiceover: In 2019, an office worker named Maya lost her job. It began when she held the office door for two seconds.
beats.visual: A woman in office clothes stands alone in a dim lobby holding a cardboard box of her desk things.

beats.voiceover: It was a rainy Monday. A man in a wet coat ran up behind her. "Please, wait," he said. Maya smiled and held the office door.
beats.visual: A woman holds a glass office door open in the rain as a man in a wet coat hurries toward it.

beats.voiceover: The man did not work there. He walked past the desks, took a laptop, and left. Nobody looked up.
beats.visual: A man in a wet coat slides a laptop into his bag and walks calmly between busy office desks.

beats.voiceover: That laptop held the private files of two hundred customers. By night, they were for sale online. The company called the police.
beats.visual: A laptop screen in a dark room shows a long list of files, each with a price beside it.

beats.voiceover: The door camera showed one thing. Maya let the thief in. The company fired her that week. She had only held the office door. New workers still watch that video on their first day.
beats.visual: New office workers sit in a training room watching a door camera video of a woman holding a door open.

title: The Photo of the New Keys
trigger: posted a photo of her new keys
chain: the nurse posts a clear photo of her new keys outside her building
a stranger finds the building and copies the shape of the key
he opens her door while she is at work
nothing is broken, so the insurance company does not pay

beats.voiceover: In 2021, a young nurse lost everything she owned in one night. It began when she posted a photo of her new keys.
beats.visual: A young nurse in work clothes sits on the floor of an empty apartment with her head down.

beats.voiceover: She had just moved into her first apartment. She was proud. She posted a photo of her new keys, outside her building. It took two seconds.
beats.visual: A smiling nurse holds up shiny new keys in front of her apartment building and takes a photo with her phone.

beats.voiceover: A stranger saw it. The building was easy to find. The shape of the key was easy to copy.
beats.visual: A man on a dark street looks from a photo on his phone up to the front of an apartment building.

beats.voiceover: On a Tuesday night, she was working at the hospital. He opened her door. He took her laptop, her gold, and her savings. He did not break the lock.
beats.visual: A man in dark clothes quietly opens an apartment door with a key and steps into a dark living room.

beats.voiceover: The insurance company found no broken door and no broken window. It refused to pay. She had posted a photo of her new keys. The stranger had even liked it.
beats.visual: An insurance worker shakes his head at an unbroken apartment door while the nurse stands silent behind him.

title: The Stranger's Bag
chain: the engineer holds a stranger's bag
the stranger sees a police dog and walks away
the dog finds drugs in the bag
only the engineer's fingerprints are on it

beats.voiceover: In 2017, an engineer went to jail for eight months. It began when he held a stranger's bag at the airport.
beats.visual: A man in a plain grey jail uniform sits alone on a narrow bed, looking at the floor.

beats.voiceover: A man in grey gloves asked for help. "Please hold my bag for two seconds." The engineer was kind. He held a stranger's bag.
beats.visual: In a busy airport hall, an engineer takes a black bag from a man wearing grey gloves.

beats.voiceover: The man bent down. Then he stood up and walked into the crowd. He had seen the police dog before anyone else.
beats.visual: A man in grey gloves walks away through a crowd while a police officer with a dog enters the hall.

beats.voiceover: The dog sat down beside the bag. Officers opened it and found drugs. "It is not mine," the engineer said. Nobody could find the other man.
beats.visual: A police dog sits beside a black bag while two officers open it and the engineer raises his empty hands.

beats.voiceover: Only one man's fingerprints were on that bag. A judge sent the engineer to jail. He had only held a stranger's bag. The man in the gloves was already on a plane.
beats.visual: Through an airplane window, a man in grey gloves fastens his seat belt as the plane leaves the gate.
